slides.title: Memes
slides.text:
WHAT'S SO FUNNY
This month in AI memes
THE OFFICE · “EVEN HARDER”
Microslop: “I’m gonna implement AI even harder”
The “stop — I’m gonna do it even harder” format, aimed at Microsoft (“Microslop”). Everyone’s begging companies to stop bolting AI onto everything; Microsoft answers by cramming Copilot in even harder.
SEE THE MEME ↗
FAT CAT · PARAMETER RACE
Mistral releases “Le Chaton Fat” — 24T params, très lourd
A pun on Mistral’s real assistant “Le Chat” → “Le Chaton” (kitten) + “Fat”: a 24-trillion-parameter model drawn as an obese cat, mocking the “bigger is better” parameter race (“some models scale, some develop gravity”). Maximum French branding optional.
SEE THE MEME ↗
PAINTER & MONSTER
Amodei paints the AI monster he warns us about
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, painting the AI monster himself — his drumbeat that AI is too dangerous and governments should be able to block it (he called for exactly that in June 2026). Then he panics at the monster he conjured: a jab that the doom-hype is self-serving.
SPOOF HEADLINE · SATIRE
Musk runs a 6-hour task on Fable 5, sees the Anthropic bill
An invented headline (satire, not a real report): Elon Musk “loses trillionaire status” after accidentally running a 6-hour task on Fable 5 — “saw the Anthropic bill and fainted.” Frontier-model compute is the punchline, landing right on this month’s motto: AI now costs more than the humans it replaces.
SEE THE MEME ↗

slides.title: /loop
slides.text:
DEEP DIVE · HOW PEOPLE ACTUALLY CODE NOW
Stop prompting. Start looping. 🔁
🦞 Workflow
🦞
Peter Steinberger
✔
@steipete · PSPDFKit founder · agentic-coding evangelist
𝕏

Here's your monthly reminder that you shouldn't be prompting coding agents anymore. You should be designing loops that prompt your agents.

Jun 8, 2026 · 6.5M views
🧑‍💻 Prompting
🔁 Looping
Prompting (old)

You type → it answers → you read → you type again. You're holding the wheel the whole time.

1
Prompt
2
Act
3
Check
4
Done?
▶
STEP
Run #1 · start at Prompt

Each click = one step. If the check fails, it loops back. When tests go green, the loop exits.

claude-code
/loop babysit all my PRs. Auto-fix build issues, and when comments come in, use a worktree agent to fix them.

In Claude Code, /loop runs a prompt on repeat — or, with no interval, self-paces until the job is done.

⚠ A loop with nothing to push back is just the agent agreeing with itself on repeat. Same guy, 6 months earlier: “Just talk to it.” The tools finally got good enough to loop.
